clips.title: The story
paras: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is desperate to escape his posting in Southshore and return south to Stormwind City. Sensing a career opportunity after hearing Alliance High Command fears the rising threat of the naga, he hires an adventurer to exterminate the serpent-folk so he can claim the credit and secure a reassignment.

Southshore sits on the knife-edge of Lordaeron, hemmed in by Forsaken forces, syndicate brigands, and relentless sea fiends. For Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, an ordinary guardsman accustomed to city drunks and petty brawls in Stormwind, the posting is nothing short of miserable. When word arrives from his former mentor that Alliance High Command is increasingly anxious about the naga encroaching on the coasts, Farren spots his golden opportunity to leave the north behind.

Despite his lofty ambitions, Farren is candid about his cowardice: facing ferocious Daggerspine sirens and shorehunters in open combat is far beyond his courage and ability. Instead of risking his neck, he commissions an adventurer to scour the beaches southeast of Southshore, cull the naga ranks, and provide the martial feats he needs to draft an impressive dispatch to Major Samuelson in Stormwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My former mentor in the Stormwind city guard sent a message to me that Alliance High Command is becoming concerned with the threat posed by the naga. From what he's heard, there's good chances for promotion--or at least reassignment--for anyone who proves valuable in this regard.

There's just one small problem... I can't handle the naga, friend. Oh sure, I could break up a drunken barroom brawl, or haul off a belligerent beggar, but the naga are too much for me. You've got to help me, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I've a letter ready to go to Major Samuelson in Stormwind. All I need are the results.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With the naga put down in Southshore, I'll be a shoe-in to be reassigned. I'll get to see Stormwind again... Get away from this Light-forsaken port.
